title: Discovery of novel polysubstituted N-alkyl acridone analogues as histone deacetylase isoform-selective inhibitors for cancer therapy.
authors: Wang, Ze; Zhao, Li; Zhang, Bo; Feng, Jiahe; Wang, Yule; Zhang, Bin; Jin, Haixiao; Ding, Lijian; Wang, Ning; He, Shan
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型HDAC抑制剂设计与抗癌活性，涉及小分子-蛋白互作，但对象为酶抑制剂而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pan-histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors often have some toxic side effects. In this study, three series of novel polysubstituted N-alkyl acridone analogous were designed and synthesised as HDAC isoform-selective inhibitors. Among them, 11b and 11c exhibited selective inhibition of HDAC1, HDAC3, and HDAC10, with IC(50) values ranging from 87 nM to 418 nM. However, these compounds showed no inhibitory effect against HDAC6 and HDAC8. Moreover, 11b and 11c displayed potent antiproliferative activity against leukaemia HL-60 cells and colon cancer HCT-116 cells, with IC(50) values ranging from 0.56 muM to 4.21 muM. Molecular docking and energy scoring functions further analysed the differences in the binding modes of 11c with HDAC1/6. In vitro anticancer studies revealed that the hit compounds 11b and 11c effectively induced histone H3 acetylation, S-phase cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis in HL-60 cells in a concentration-dependent manner.
abstract_zh: 泛组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂常伴有某些毒性副作用。本研究设计并合成了三个系列的新型多取代N-烷基吖啶酮类似物，作为HDAC亚型选择性抑制剂。其中，11b和11c对HDAC1、HDAC3和HDAC10表现出选择性抑制，IC(50)值范围为87 nM至418 nM。然而，这些化合物对HDAC6和HDAC8无抑制活性。此外，11b和11c对白血病HL-60细胞和结肠癌HCT-116细胞显示出强效抗增殖活性，IC(50)值范围为0.56 μM至4.21 μM。分子对接和能量评分函数进一步分析了11c与HDAC1/6结合模式的差异。体外抗癌研究表明，命中化合物11b和11c以浓度依赖性方式有效诱导HL-60细胞中组蛋白H3乙酰化、S期细胞周期阻滞和凋亡。
